slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: The brief says to minimize overtime, but it doesn't define what overtime is or how it relates to the 110 weekly production hours — is the 110 hours the regular (non-overtime) capacity, with any production beyond it counting as overtime to be minimized, or is 110 hours the total available time including overtime, with overtime being a separate tracked quantity?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent clarified the role of the 110 hours relative to overtime, but did not ask whether full utilization of 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft prioritized goal.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the 10-hour overtime limit or whether it is a strict constraint versus a prioritized soft goal.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 110 regular hours are treated as a capacity threshold, with overtime defined as production time beyond 110 hours, rather than as a prioritized goal to fully utilize 110 hours.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent asked about the meaning of 110 hours relative to overtime, but did not confirm whether fully utilizing 110 hours is a hard constraint or a soft goal with priority.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The 10-hour overtime limit is not modeled or treated as a goal/constraint; the model only minimizes overtime.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the 10-hour overtime limit or its priority, so its omission from the model is an unconfirmed assumption.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P0 hidden slots about the nature and priority of the 110-hour utilization goal and the 10-hour overtime limit remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified overtime definition, minimum production, shifts, and profit relevance, but missed the key P0 goal-programming structure: whether full 110-hour utilization and the 10-hour overtime limit are hard constraints or prioritized soft goals. It stopped prematurely with those core modeling facts unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
